quote: Every vehicle driven upon a divided highway must be driven only upon the right-hand roadway and must not be driven over, across or within any dividing space, barrier or section or make any left turn, semicircular turn or U-turn, except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

activation.condition: vehicle is driven on a divided highway

obligation.description: drive outside the right-hand roadway, cross the divider, or make a U-turn outside the stated opening/crossover exceptions

exceptions.trigger: physical opening or public-authority-established crossover or intersection
exceptions.effect: the stated turning/crossing prohibition has an exception at the sourced place
exceptions.replacement_obligation: retain right-hand-roadway and actual opening/crossover context for review
exceptions.source_clause: except through an opening in the barrier or dividing section or space or at a crossover or intersection established by a public authority.

timing.description: while driving, crossing the divider or making the U-turn

parameter_refs.name: opening_source
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: same sourced physical median opening and barrier sections

parameter_refs.name: ego_body_uturn_observed
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original complete-body motion and gear history
